10_grasp_point.rule: grasp = (blob_x, blob_y, min(blob_z - 0.012, table_top + 0.02 + 0.002)); with blob_z about table_top + 0.043 the height is always table_top + 0.022, so only the blob XY matters

11_partial_blob_centroid.calibrated_fact: the colour mask captures the top face only (side faces are shaded below the colour threshold); see clean_blob_calibration.json
11_partial_blob_centroid.rule: the centroid is the mean of the VISIBLE top-face points only; a partially hidden top face shifts it toward the visible part

12_allowed_spatial_error.affect_zone_note: a bias can change the outcome once bias + controller tolerance reaches the smaller slack
12_allowed_spatial_error.derivation: open finger inner face 0.0399 m - cube half 0.020 m
12_allowed_spatial_error.orthogonal_derivation: pad centre leaves the cube face when the offset reaches the cube half width
12_allowed_spatial_error.spread_axis: world y (derived from the saved eef quaternion; see world_safe_grid.json)

13_path_tolerances.press: tol 0.01 (80 steps; already satisfied at the grasp height, so no extra motion)

1_colour_segmentation.rule: per-pixel Euclidean RGB distance to the object colour < THRESHOLDS['color_tol'] on rgb/255

2_minimum_blob.rule: mask pixels < min_pixels, or finite depth-valid pixels < min_pixels, gives no blob

3_centroid.rule: xyz = mean over ALL depth-valid mask pixels of the back-projected world points (rec['xyz'] = pts.mean(0))

4_depth.rule: _metric_depth: robosuite get_real_depth_map(env.sim, depth) on the flipped normalized depth; fallback only if that fails

5_pixel_to_world.rule: x_cam=(xs-cx)*z/f, y_cam=(ys-cy)*z/f, p_cam=[x_cam,-y_cam,-z], p_world = R p_cam + t with the live agentview camera; f=0.5*128/tan(fovy/2), cx=cy=(128-1)/2

6_unknown.rule: blob missing -> Held/OnTable/Inside/AtBuffer = UNKNOWN (reason object_blob_missing); lid or container missing -> Open UNKNOWN; container/buffer fall back to the static layout instead of UNKNOWN

7_OnTable.note: the blob z is the mean z of the visible TOP-FACE points (about table_top + 0.043), 0.018 from the reference, inside the tolerance
7_OnTable.rule: TRUE when |blob_z - (table_z + 0.025)| < table_z_tol (0.05) and the object is not held; FALSE if held; else UNKNOWN

8_pick_mask_depends_on_visibility.mechanism: contract PICK pre_pos = GripperEmpty and OnTable(?o); OnTable(o) is UNKNOWN when the object has no blob, so the PICK mask turns FALSE for an undetected object (hard, not soft)

9_object_xyz_read_by_executor.rule: _object_xyz: refresh perception (env.last_perception = table_xyz of the current blobs) and read perc[name][:3]; missing -> PerceptionMissing / CriticalFactLost
